name: Bangor University
description:
Do you want to study at a university situated close to the sea and mountains?

Bangor University is located in North Wales: an area named the 4th best region in the world to visit by the travel guide Lonely Planet!

A whopping 2,000 international students from 126 countries choose to study at Bangor University, creating a diverse campus.

The University boasts an 81% overall satisfaction rate - far above the UK average of 76% because the university creates a welcoming environment for all, with regular events and the celebration of all faiths.

Bangor University has a great reputation in multiple fields:

  • Accounting & Finance
  • Sport Science
  • Electronic Engineering 

Are you concerned about the transition to a new nation and the academic environment? Do you wonder whether the university you've selected provides support and resources tailored for students of diverse backgrounds? Are you curious about whether enrolling in this institution could boost your prospects of securing a prestigious job globally after you graduate?

Discover why Bangor University might just be the place for you!

View courses now

Founded in 1884, Bangor University has an established tradition of academic excellence and a concentration on the wellbeing and experiences of students. Bangor is also a recognised research institution which is ranked by the Research Excellence Framework with more than three-quarters of it's work being either world-leaning or outstanding globally. This forms part of a distinctive learning experience with over 400 programmes on offer to students.

Student Life

The International Student Support Office runs a social programme that includes free events as well as trips around the local area and to specific destinations. It also organises a One World Gala concert held every year that celebrates the many nationalities of students.

Campus Life runs events especially for students living in University halls of residence too.

highlights.value:

The University boasts an 81% overall satisfaction rate – far above the UK average of 76% because the University creates a welcoming environment for all, with regular events and the celebration of all faiths.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
Bangor University has around 2,000 international students.

The International Student Support Office runs a social programme that includes free events as well as trips around the local area and to specific destinations. It also organises a One World Gala concert every year to celebrate the many nationalities of students.

The Campus Life programme is committed to supporting interaction between students to foster a close residential community. Campus Life runs events, especially for students living in University halls of residence.

There are over 150 clubs and societies to choose from in Bangor. Academi is Bangor’s student club.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Bangor University provides on-campus accommodation to students. The housing was rated 3rd for Halls and Accommodation at the WhatUni Student Choice Awards 2023. The accommodation is self-catered, with private bathrooms, and shared kitchen facilities.

All international students with an offer to enrol on a September course are guaranteed a room in Bangor University halls. All residence halls include wi-fi and wired internet access, and a gym membership.

There are two accommodation villages, Ffriddoedd and St Mary's, within walking distance of the main University buildings and the city centre.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Sports
The Students' Union has over 50 sports teams and clubs which you can join for free. On-campus sports facilities include two main sports halls, well-equipped gyms, a gymnastics hall, and more. Outdoor facilities include grass pitches for football, rugby and American football, a shared athletics track and many more.

Cafeteria
There are also two bars and a cafe run by the student union. The Pontio Centre is a social hub for students.
